title: 第 90章 惹了师父

第 90章 惹了师父-《穿越60带着空间当保安》

伸了个懒腰，穿衣，下床，迎着第一缕阳光王野站在院子中心，微闭双目，深吸一口气，回忆着赵爷爷打拳的过程，呼吸。在之前他自认为学的很好，现在想来却不是那么回事儿。

原来只觉那一招一式刚猛无比，仿佛蕴含着无尽的力量。然而，他的心却如同狂风中的落叶，浮躁而动荡。

每次练习，他都急于求成，掌握那些强大的招式。这是王底层的潜意识作祟，他想要强大，想要自保，这是他身为一个外来者内心的不安。经过东北之行，再加上昨晚的梦境，他想通了，自己就是这个时代的一员。

在这个底层逻辑下，王野一通百通，很多事情都知道怎阳曲处理了，想通了赵爷爷打拳为什么看着普普通通，细细回忆下又是那样的稳而厚重。

突出这口气，王野打起了原来练的最少的八极小架，这是八极的入门拳法，在王野学会后就很少练习。当再次打起时，每一招每一式都与之前有天壤之别。如果说王野之前与赵爷爷相比只是形似，当这遍拳打完，就有了六分神似了。

当王野打第二遍时，赵爷爷从屋里出来。看着自己最在意的衣钵传人，有了长足的进步。迷上本就不大的眼睛，嘴角不经意的上扬。

直到王野打完第三遍，静静的站在那里深深的吐了一口浊气。赵爷爷走上前去关切的问道：“怎么样，是不是感觉不一样了？”

看到赵爷爷关切的眼神王野回到：“是不一样了，赵爷爷我是不是又突破了？”

赵爷爷拉着王野进入练功房，经过一番检验点点头说道：“是突破了，你现在应该有明劲巅峰实力了。”

王野兴奋极了，拉住赵爷爷的手就问：“赵爷爷，我都明劲巅峰了，是不是要不了多久就能进入暗劲儿了？”

赵爷爷甩开王野的手：“想什么美事儿呢，后面可没有这么容易了，要全靠水磨功夫了。”

听了这话王野沮丧的哦了一声，赵爷爷一巴掌轻轻的打在王野脑袋上：“你个臭小子还不知足，一个十六岁的明劲儿巅峰，你还想怎样呀？”

说完赵爷爷就出门了，王野嘿嘿笑着跟在后面。简单洗漱下就开始吃饭了，吃完饭在秦婉收拾碗筷时王野问王铁柱：“爹，厂里是不是奖励我一张自行车票呀？”

王铁柱点点头：“是啊，怎么了？”

王野：“那票呢？”

王铁柱点了根儿烟：“我要拿东西也没用呀，给你娘了。”

秦婉警惕的说道：“别打主意啊，这张票我得留着，将来你娶媳妇再买。”

王野：“娘，你想啥呢，票据都是有时间限制的。等到我结婚那东西早就过期了。”

秦婉像看傻子一样看着王野：“我还不知道有时间限制呀，我可以借给急需的人家，等你快结婚时再让他还。”

王野：“万一人家赖账呢？”

秦婉：“放心，我可以找街道办的担保，没人敢耍赖。”

Stretched, got dressed, and got out of bed. Facing the first ray of sunshine, Wang Ye stood in the center of the yard. He closed his eyes slightly, took a deep breath, and recalled the process of Grandpa Zhao's boxing.He thought he had studied well before, but now that he thinks about it, that is not the case.

It turned out that each move was extremely powerful, as if it contained endless power.However, his heart was like fallen leaves in the strong wind, impetuous and turbulent.

Every time he practices, he is eager to achieve success and master those powerful moves.This is the subconscious work of the bottom Wang. He wants to be strong and protect himself. This is his inner uneasiness as an outsider.After his trip to the Northeast and his dream last night, he figured out that he was a member of this era.

Under this underlying logic, Wang Ye understood everything, and Yang Qu solved many things. He figured out why Grandpa Zhao's boxing looked ordinary, but when he recalled it carefully, it was so stable and heavy.

Emphasizing this tone, Wang Ye started the Baji fight that he had practiced the least before. This was Baji's introductory boxing technique, and he rarely practiced it after Wang Ye learned it.When the fight started again, every move and style was completely different from before.If Wang Ye had only a physical resemblance to Grandpa Zhao before, after this punch, there was a six-point resemblance in spirit.

When Wang Ye was playing for the second time, Grandpa Zhao came out of the house.Seeing that the person he cares about most has made great progress.Fascinated by the small eyes, the corners of the mouth raised inadvertently.

Until Wang Ye finished playing for the third time, he stood there quietly and took a deep breath.Grandpa Zhao stepped forward and asked with concern: "How are you doing? Do you feel different?"

Seeing Grandpa Zhao's concerned eyes, Wang Ye returned: "It's different. Grandpa Zhao, did I break through again?"

Grandpa Zhao pulled Wang Ye into the practice room. After some testing, he nodded and said, "It's a breakthrough. You should now have Ming Jin's peak strength."

Wang Ye was so excited that he took Grandpa Zhao's hand and asked, "Grandpa Zhao, I have reached the peak of Ming Jin. Will I be able to enter Dark Jin'er soon?"

Grandpa Zhao shook off Wang Ye's hand: "What good things are you thinking about? It won't be so easy later. It will all depend on hard work."

After hearing this, Wang Ye let out a frustrated sound, and Grandpa Zhao gently slapped Wang Ye on the head: "You brat are not satisfied yet. A sixteen-year-old Ming Jin'er is at his peak, what else do you want?"

After speaking, Grandpa Zhao went out, and Wang Ye followed behind with a smile.After briefly washing up, he started to eat. After dinner, while Qin Wan was clearing away the dishes, Wang Ye asked Wang Tiezhu: "Dad, is the factory going to reward me with a bicycle ticket?"

Wang Tiezhu nodded: "Yes, what's wrong?"

Wang Ye: "What about the votes?"

Wang Tiezhu lit a cigarette: "It's useless for me to get anything, I'll give it to your mother."

Qin Wan said warily: "Don't make any decisions. I have to keep this ticket. I will buy it when you get a wife in the future."

Wang Ye: "Mom, what are you thinking about? The bills are time-limited. By the time I get married, they will have expired."

Qin Wan looked at Wang Ye as if he were a fool: "I didn't know there was a time limit. I can lend it to someone who urgently needs it and let him return it when you are about to get married."

Wang Ye: "What if someone defaults on the bill?"

Qin Wan: "Don't worry, I can get a guarantee from the street office, no one dares to cheat."
